Ten full-length mock exams (1,750 questions in all) built to the ANCC Psychiatric–Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (Across the Lifespan) test content outline: 175 questions each, 150 scored and 25 unscored pretest items, mixed together just like the real exam. Scored items per exam: Scientific Foundation 33 (22%), Advanced Practice Skills 41 (27%), Diagnosis and Treatment 33 (22%), Psychotherapy and Related Theories 17 (11%), and Ethics, Legal Principles and Cultural Care 26 (17%).
